description: The second-level quotient census: the classical quotients (even, odd companion, reciprocal, reciprocal twist) applied recursively (levels 2-4) to every level-1 endpoint core of every finite component of every live frame of every open class (compute/second_level_census.py; CORE_RECORD_DEGREE = 100).  A frame's degree = the largest over its finite components of the smallest endpoint degree the component reaches; a class's = the smallest over its frames.  A class GAINS when some frame reaches degree <= 6 only through the deeper levels.  Sixteen (3,1,1) classes gain, in two families: R5's eight (G2 rank 3, G3 rank 2, T5 = (z + 4) G2 rank 2: closed by rank) and eight more through two new curves U1, U2 (see families.U for Magma's verdict).  The module now chains the classical quotients to depth 4 (CLASSICAL_DEPTH).

lmfdb.label: 230224.a.920896.1
lmfdb.identification: equal absolute Igusa-Clebsch invariants (Sage; the LMFDB's normalised invariants [480, 9552, 1243416, 115112])

R5.outcome: every piece has rank >= genus: closed by rank

U1b.reading: U1 = U2 over Q; the 2-Selmer bound 4 is not improvable by a Richelot isogeny; the rank is between 1 and 4

U.dry_run: with PARI's small points as the complete point set, the frame's fibers over them are empty and the fiber over infinity holds only the degenerate points (0, 0), (0, +-1): a decision of U1 or U2 with those points kills (scratch test_st7.py)
U.outcome: undecided: 2-Selmer bound 4 on both, rank >= 1 (U2 has a point of infinite order); a rank bound of 1 would kill all eight (the dry run)

module.note: the classical quotients chained to depth 4 with fresh variable names per level and the twist roots of every level pulled back through their own composed maps (patch of 2026-09-16)
